title: Marketing for Architects | Cambridge Marketing College

facts.fact: The podcast page 'Marketing for Architects' is dated 11 July 2025.
Susie Lober is described as a marketing consultant specialising in marketing for architects, and her company is called Lo Marketing.
facts.quote: I'm very pleased to welcome Susie Lober, who is a marketing consultant specialising in marketing for architects.

facts.fact: Susie Lober's degree was in history, and she moved into marketing after working in an administrative role at an architecture practice.
Lo Marketing's name is said to come from the old English word 'lo', which means to draw attention to good things, and the initials L-O are also said to stand for 'little and often'.
facts.quote: Lo Marketing comes from the old English word lo L-O, not L-O-W, which means to draw attention to good things, which is what I try and do.

facts.fact: According to the podcast summary, bid writing and getting on pre-approved panels are important marketing activities for architects because they compete for public and private sector projects.
facts.quote: Bid writing and getting on pre-approved panels are important marketing activities for architects, as they compete for public and private sector projects.

facts.fact: According to the podcast summary, many small architecture firms lack in-house marketing expertise, and Lober offers strategic marketing planning services to help them identify ideal clients and develop marketing tactics.
facts.quote: Many small architecture firms lack in-house marketing expertise, so Lober provides strategic marketing planning services

facts.fact: According to the podcast summary, word-of-mouth referrals are common in the architecture industry, but Lober advises firms to take a more proactive, multi-channel approach.
facts.quote: Word-of-mouth referrals are common in the architecture industry, but Lober advises firms to take a more proactive, multi-channel approach

facts.fact: Lober is editor of a local architecture magazine, according to the podcast summary.
facts.quote: Lober's role as editor of a local architecture magazine provides her with unique access and insights into the industry.
